simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to צֵן (H6791) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: צֵן (tsên) means a thorn ; hence, a cactus-hedge First listed occurrence: Job 5 5.

definitions.full: H6791. tsen [ צֵן ] noun [masculine] thorn? barb? ; — plural צִנִּים Prov 22:5 (+ מַּחִים ); וְאֶלמִֿצִּנִּים Job 5:5 from (behind) thorns (a protecting thorn hedge, so Di), but very dubious; Che JQ July, 1897, 576 strike out as doublet of צַמִּים ; Bev JPhil. xxvi. 305 proposes צִנִּים וְאִנָם [ and as to their wealth, barbs (? barbed spears) take it].
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to be prickly;
